diagnostics.summary: Rule with path '/Probe2/CheckRule': Missing specification of an asterisk for 'Rows' in '/Probe2/Rows/DateSub'. [MVK_NO_WILDCARD]
diagnostics.fix: A repeatable group is referenced from a rule that does not iterate over it — the fix is operator-dependent. For an AGGREGATE, flatten the repetitions with the `*` wildcard: Sum(Lines*/Amount), NumberOfFilledFields(Lines*/Sku), NumberOfFilledGroups(Lines*). For a PER-REPETITION predicate (RepetitionNotUnique / CurrentRepetition), make the rule iterate by putting its group at the PARENT of the repeated group with the error field inside it — via the CLI, `rule check --group <parentGroup> --field <parentGroup>/<repeatedGroup>/<field>` (e.g. --group /Order --field /Order/Items/Sku for RepetitionNotUnique(Items/Sku)).
diagnostics.explain: MVK_NO_WILDCARD fires when a repeatable group is referenced from a non-iterating scope: the kernel expected either a flattening `*` (aggregates) or a rule that iterates over that group (per-repetition predicates). The required form depends on the operator, so this code is not specific to any single one.
